items.title: Flatness of a module and of its base change along a local diagram, both directions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a local commutative diagram where one ring is a localisation of a tensor product, flatness of a module passes to its base change, and conversely descends when the base map is flat, with the corresponding statements for flat ring maps as special cases (statement lines 24401-24423). The proof does not chase Tor: it identifies the base-changed module as a localisation of the tensor product, obtains the forward direction from the base change lemma, and in the other direction tensors an injection with the flat base, localises, and uses flatness of the base-changed module to conclude (proof lines 24425-24454). Recognising the base-changed module as a localisation is the step that makes both directions accessible. H2.
